lba_qa.q: On a graph, a point is 4 units to the right of the origin and 3 units up. Write its coordinates.
lba_qa.a:
The horizontal distance (x-coordinate) = 4.
The vertical distance (y-coordinate) = 3.

Coordinates are written as (x, y) = (4, 3).

So the point is (4, 3). ✅

lba_qa.q: A line graph shows a shop's sales: Monday 20, Tuesday 35, Wednesday 25 units. On which day were sales highest, and by how much did sales rise from Monday to Tuesday?
lba_qa.a:
Highest sales = 35 units on Tuesday.

Rise from Monday to Tuesday = 35 - 20 = 15 units.

So Tuesday had the highest sales, rising by 15 units from Monday. ✅

lba_qa.q: What are the coordinates of the origin on a graph?
lba_qa.a:
The origin is the point where the x-axis and y-axis meet.
There, both distances are 0.

So the coordinates of the origin are (0, 0). ✅

lba_qa.q: A point lies on the x-axis, 5 units to the right of the origin. What are its coordinates?
lba_qa.a:
On the x-axis the y-coordinate is always 0.
The point is 5 units right, so x = 5.

So the coordinates are (5, 0). ✅

lba_qa.q: A car travels at a steady speed. In 1 hour it covers 40 km, in 2 hours 80 km, in 3 hours 120 km. If we plot time on the x-axis and distance on the y-axis, what kind of graph do we get?
lba_qa.a:
As time increases, distance increases by an equal amount (40 km each hour).
Such equally-spaced points lie on a straight line.

So the graph is a straight line (a linear graph passing through the origin). ✅

lba_qa.q: From the point (2, 3), if we move 3 units right and 1 unit up, what are the coordinates of the new point?
lba_qa.a:
Moving right increases the x-coordinate; moving up increases the y-coordinate.
New x = 2 + 3 = 5.
New y = 3 + 1 = 4.

So the new point is (5, 4). ✅

lba_qa.q: A point lies on the y-axis, 6 units above the origin. Write its coordinates.
lba_qa.a:
On the y-axis the x-coordinate is always 0.
The point is 6 units up, so y = 6.

So the coordinates are (0, 6). ✅

lba_qa.q: Which type of graph best shows how the temperature of a city changes continuously through the day?
lba_qa.a:
A line graph is used to show data that changes continuously over time.

Temperature changing hour by hour is continuous data, so a line graph is best. ✅

lba_qa.q: A bank account earns simple interest. The graph of interest against number of years is a straight line through the origin. If the interest after 2 years is 400 rupees, what is it after 5 years?
lba_qa.a:
Since the graph is a straight line through the origin, interest is in direct proportion to years.
Interest per year = 400 / 2 = 200 rupees.
Interest after 5 years = 5 x 200 = 1000 rupees.

So the interest after 5 years is 1000 rupees. ✅

lba_qa.q: In the coordinate pair (7, 2), what does the number 7 represent?
lba_qa.a:
In an ordered pair (x, y), the first number is the x-coordinate.
It tells the horizontal distance from the y-axis.

So 7 is the x-coordinate, the distance to the right of the y-axis. ✅
